name: Chase overdue Xero invoices (The Gantry blueprint)

parameters.content:
## Chase overdue Xero invoices
Blueprint by The Gantry (gantry.work).

1. Fill in **Settings** (company, sender, owner email, PayNow/bank details, reminder days).
2. Connect your Xero account on **Get unpaid invoices** and **Get customer email**, and pick your organisation.
3. Connect Gmail on both Gmail steps.
4. Test once with the owner email as a customer email in a Xero test contact.
5. Activate. Sent reminders are remembered only while the workflow is active.

assignments.name: paymentDetails
assignments.value: PayNow to UEN [your UEN], or bank transfer to [bank name and account number], quoting the invoice number.
